Rank one and the one-sided nullcone are safe. SIC2B33ODD20261116 now closes the entire ten-dimensional odd-harmonic Sym^6+Sym^2 slice, including mixtures and boundaries, with the sharp strict cutoff m>deg_(Z,Y)Q. The remaining structural question couples spherical H2 (Sym^4) to H3+H1; the common cubic radial lift would require sqrt(x.x). The transfer inherits the retained homogeneous Gaussian cubic theorem's independent-review boundary. SIC2B33SP9 now proves that every mixed standard-basis coefficient support of size at most nine is SIC-safe, so any counterexample has at least ten nonzero coefficients in that basis. At size nine, the earlier rectangle, fringe, cross, three-line, and full-line theorems close 3554 supports; SIC2B33FI9 closes the 816 supports of type (3,2,2,2)^2, including two unique rational rank-three fixed-flag points; and the final exact QQ unit calculation closes the other 7050 full-incidence supports.
